label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Rohan, fair question da. Sneha, let him ask — he and Divya trusted me with 3 lakh, he’s allowed to ask for an update without waiting for my next LinkedIn gratitude ceremony.

Straight answer: your money is at risk. It’s not gone, but I genuinely cannot promise you’ll get it back. So yes, the investment is still a thing. Whether it turns into a good thing is what we’re trying to work out. You deserve the actual picture, not “we’re crushing it” with a rocket emoji.

The Hyderabad fund bridge round fell through on 28 Oct. Term sheet was basically ready, and then it didn’t happen. The partner said “we love the energy” and stopped replying for 11 days. Apparently energy is renewable but funding is not. Still, it was my job to plan for the money not coming, so I’m not going to make this entirely a story about a VC not answering his phone.

Last Friday we let go of 6 out of 14 people. Everyone got two months’ pay, and we’ve helped four get interviews already. Those are interviews, not jobs, so there’s still work to do there. It was honestly the worst day of my life. These people had put a lot into building this with us, and I had to tell them we couldn’t keep them on.

After the cuts, we have about five months of runway. That gives us time to try the narrower plan properly, but not time to keep doing everything and hope something magically works.

The app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbing and electrical are growing. AC servicing is bleeding money, and we’re going to shut that side down. The focus now is housing society tie-ups; three societies in HSR have already signed pilots. That’s something concrete to work on, though signed pilots aren’t the same as a business that pays its bills.

I honestly think we have a real shot with the societies. I also thought the bridge was going to happen, so please take my optimism alongside the numbers, not instead of them.

You and Divya came into the 2025 friends round on the same terms as everyone else. Being friends doesn’t mean you should have to piece together what’s happening from my posts. Let’s do a proper call this week, all three of us. I’ll show you the numbers, where the cash is going and what we need to see from these pilots. Ask whatever you both need to.

And gang, I’m okay. Stressed, yes. Eating office Maggi at 11pm often enough that security uncle now asks “masala or plain?” Amma has also asked whether TCS is still hiring, so the family contingency planning department is active.

I’m coming Saturday. Happy to talk, also happy to discuss literally anything that doesn’t have the word runway in it. Pranav is buying. That funding round I would like confirmed before Friday.
